name: Solicitation Intake
description: Structure an RFP, RFI, or formal solicitation intake discussion.

sections.title: Objectives and Scope
sections.instruction: Summarize the buyer's objectives, requested scope, and deliverables discussed.

sections.title: Dates and Instructions
sections.instruction: List submission dates, milestones, format instructions, and process requirements mentioned.

sections.title: Evaluation and Compliance
sections.instruction: List evaluation factors, mandatory requirements, and compliance items.

sections.title: Questions and Gaps
sections.instruction: List clarification questions, missing source material, and unresolved interpretations.

sections.title: Dependencies and Risks
sections.instruction: List dependencies, risks, and constraints affecting the response.

sections.title: Owners and Actions
sections.instruction: List response actions with owners and dates when stated.
